sentences.text:
Halima Khatoon vs Unknown on 9 November, 2023
09.11.2023 Court No.8 Item. 54 (Sandip/Suvendu) Crm(Db) 4240 Of 2023 In Re: An application
for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed in connection with Entally
Police Station Case No. 385 of 2021 dated 27.11.2021 under Section 307 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, later charge-sheet filed under Sections 498A/302/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
read with Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 pending in the Court of the learned
Additional District and Sessions Judge, 2nd Fast Track Court, Sealdah, South 24 Parganas.
And In the matter of: Halima Khatoon . .. . . . . .Petitioner.
Mr. S.D.Mahapatra Mr. A.A. Alamgir for the Petitioner.

Mr. Swapan Banerjee Mr. Ashok Das for the State.
This is an application for renewal of prayer for bail.
Heard the learned advocates for the parties and considered the materials on record.

The previous application for bail was rejected by an order dated 5th of July, 2023 with a direction to expedite the trial and conclude the same at an early date preferably within six months from the next date fixed for recording of evidence without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
The aforesaid period as directed by the order dated 5 th of July, 2023 has still not expired.
We do not find any reason to allow the application for bail at this stage.
The application for bail is accordingly rejected.

(RAJA BASU CHOWDHURY, J.) (BISWAJIT BASU, J.)
